source: User-supplied official APK plus read-only phone settings inventories. Decompilation remains ignored under .local; this report contains summarized field/call contracts, no app code, account credentials or device identity.

theme.behavior: CustomThemeFragment submits two independent colors and one mutually exclusive style boolean. AppTheme stores all three; true selects dark primary styling with white foreground, false selects light primary styling with black foreground. These styles do not mean the application's night theme.
theme.desktop: customTheme, customAccent and customThemeDark drive preferenceThemeVariables; App effect dependencies include all three. Existing single customAccent records migrate to both colors. Drafts remain isolated until save; cancel restores all three values.

livePhotoAudio.desktop: Local persistence and actual video.muted state, including playback action and source changes.

viewing.desktop: Known preview/original URLs only. Auto responds to known transport and saveData; unknown transport defaults to normal. Cloud synchronization of this field remains pending.

hdr.nativeMeaning: Full HDR display and HDR badge; false uses ordinary display.
hdr.desktop: Current-window media-query detection implemented. Native full HDR display switching and automatic HDR upload detection remain unverified and unimplemented.

hdr_watermark.nativeWarning: Adding a watermark to HDR pictures removes HDR effects.

read.response: data.system_config is the serialized JSON settings map.

write.form: key=system_config and value=JSON of only changed fields; booleans serialize as string 1/0.

cloud.nativeQueue: SettingSynchronized observes known local settings and batches changed KV values with a 1000 ms debounce while logged in.
cloud.desktop: Explicit account-scoped reads/patches. Successful POST is followed by a GET that must explicitly contain each matching saved field; omitted/stale values and server/network errors are failures. Guest controls do not issue cloud requests.

uploadProcessing.prepare: uploadPrepareInfo.process maps each image processing action to a destination suffix. Native helper does not send watermark fields in the six prepare parameters; it relies on the account system_config.
flow: Upload the untouched image with callback x:var1=true when process is nonempty
POST source object ?x-oss-process with the server action and sys/saveas destination sourceKey+suffix
Only then return the original official image URL
uploadProcessing.livePhoto: The same processing applies to the image cover. The paired video is not run through image processing.
uploadProcessing.sdkEncoding: The official Android SDK prepends image/ to bare image actions and uses standard Base64 with retained padding for destination object and bucket. Desktop preserves that body convention.
uploadProcessing.desktopValidation: Bounded rules, bucket/endpoint/key and callback allowlists, account generation guards around every network boundary, original-byte preservation, correct callback flags/signatures, POST/HEAD ordering and failure/retry were tested with synthetic clients.
uploadProcessing.limits: No authenticated cloud/OSS write or actual watermark/HDR pixel comparison was performed. A missing HDR detector cannot be inferred from successful ordinary-image mock contracts.

verification.nativeApp: Root integrates loggedIn/onLogin props and image settings dispatch and owns native Electron checks.
verification.result: Implemented contracts pass isolated checks; complete mobile setting parity and authenticated pixel verification remain outstanding.
